Wide 16:9 horizontal composition in a clean sheltered quarry workwear issue bay. A simple freestanding garment rail holds three spaced complete unbranded garments on hangers: fluorescent yellow-green sleeveless zipped vest, orange-red long-sleeve work shirt, fluorescent yellow-green weather jacket with navy lower panels. Realistic horizontal silver torso bands and shoulder bands, long sleeves with encircling silver bands. An orderly bench below holds folded orange trousers and safety boots. images.revisionPrompt: Preserve the three hanging garments, quarry background, lighting and 16:9 composition. Remove boots, gloves, drink bottle, black equipment cases and neck label. Leave only folded orange trousers on the bench; no text, logos, labels or brand marks.
